target.title: fix(tui): run new sessions through lifecycle hooks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

TUI `/new` switched to an empty local key without running the existing Gateway session-creation lifecycle. Command hooks, `before_reset`, `session_end`, and `session_start` therefore missed TUI new-session transitions, so features such as session-memory hooks could not capture the completed parent conversation. Fixes #49918. Builds on the lifecycle-hook direction suggested in BingqingLyu/openclaw#1006.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Extract the existing `sessions.create` lifecycle into one shared Gateway-owned service.
- Route both Gateway and embedded TUI backends through that service; no new protocol field or TUI-specific core policy.
- Adopt the backend-returned canonical session key and remove the parallel empty-session path.
- Fence parent rollover against active runs and new work admissions, revalidate the parent under the fence, and serialize TUI input while creation is pending.
- Reject same-key parent replacement as invalid creation semantics, avoiding lifecycle/admission deadlocks.
- Preserve Crestodian behavior through the same backend contract.

## User Impact

`/new` now starts a genuinely persisted fresh TUI session and fires the same hook lifecycle in Gateway and `--local` modes. The parent transcript is complete before hooks run. If a turn is active or finishing, the TUI asks the user to abort or wait instead of racing the rollover.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server.sessions.create.test.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.reset-hooks.test.ts src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts src/tui/tui-command-handlers.test.ts src/tui/tui-session-actions.test.ts src/tui/tui-pty-harness.e2e.test.ts` — 70 Gateway, 172 TUI, and 14 PTY tests passed after rebase.
- `OPENCLAW_TUI_PTY_INCLUDE_LOCAL=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/tui/tui-pty-local.e2e.test.ts` — 5 real-backend PTY scenarios passed; both embedded `--local` and Gateway modes created/adopted canonical `agent:main:tui-*` sessions and sent a fresh turn through the mocked Responses endpoint.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwrjhsjn8geh91q5w6rnh5j3` — strict core TypeScript passed; final `check:changed` is running on the rebased commit.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings (overall confidence 0.91).
